definition.en: A common skin condition involving blocked and inflamed hair follicles and oil glands.

explanation.en: Acne can produce comedones, papules, pustules, or deeper inflammatory lesions.

definition.en: Partial or complete loss of hair from areas where hair normally grows.

explanation.en: Alopecia has many patterns and causes, ranging from temporary shedding to immune-mediated hair loss.

definition.en: An infection of deeper skin and subcutaneous tissues.

explanation.en: Cellulitis typically causes an area of spreading redness, warmth, swelling, and tenderness.

definition.en: Inflammation of the skin that may cause redness, itching, swelling, or scaling.

explanation.en: Dermatitis is a broad term that includes several inflammatory skin conditions.

definition.en: A group of inflammatory skin conditions characterized by dry, itchy, irritated skin.

explanation.en: Atopic dermatitis is a common form of eczema and often follows a relapsing course.

definition.en: A contagious superficial bacterial skin infection, common in children.

explanation.en: This is a high-level educational reference entry. Use the Clinical Reference workspace for related context; no individualized diagnosis or treatment guidance is provided.

definition.en: A cancer arising from pigment-producing melanocytes, most often in the skin.

explanation.en: Melanoma is important because it can spread to other parts of the body if not recognized early.

definition.en: A chronic immune-mediated skin condition that causes well-defined, scaly plaques.

explanation.en: Psoriasis commonly affects the scalp, elbows, knees, or lower back and can also involve joints.

definition.en: A visible change in the color, texture, or appearance of the skin.

explanation.en: Rash is a descriptive term rather than a single diagnosis and can have many causes.

definition.en: Raised, itchy skin welts caused by temporary swelling in the superficial skin.

explanation.en: Individual welts often change location or fade within hours, although episodes can recur.

definition.en: A break or injury in the normal structure of skin or underlying tissue.

explanation.en: Wounds can be acute or chronic and heal through coordinated inflammatory and repair processes.
